landing.heroTitle: A young person's education should not come down to luck
landing.heroText: Global Effect covers what it takes for a student to stay in school: tuition, technical training, lunch at midday, and support for when it all gets to be too much.
landing.workIntro: Nobody drops out for a single reason. That is why the Foundation does not address one need, but the four that show up together.
landing.work_scholarships_desc: Every scholarship has a sponsor with a name and a record of what the contribution paid for. Follow-up does not end when the money is handed over.
landing.work_training_desc: Academies and technical courses with subjects, terms and grades entered by the teachers themselves: a real academic record, not an attendance certificate.
landing.work_wellbeing_desc: An in-house department with appointments and follow-up. Clinical notes are confidential by design: they sit outside the reach of coordination and of the general record.
landing.work_meals_desc: Lunch for anyone who signs up before 8:30 in the morning. No paperwork, no account, no questions.
landing.sponsorTitle: Every contribution can be traced to a name
landing.sponsorIntro: The system does not hold donations that dissolve into a general budget. A contribution is assigned to a scholarship, the scholarship to a student, and that student has subjects, grades and a record you can look at.
landing.sponsor_traceability_desc: From the transaction to the scholarship, and from the scholarship to the student. Every step is recorded with its date.
landing.sponsor_records_desc: Grades by term, enrolled subjects and academic progress, kept up to date by the people teaching the classes.
landing.sponsor_reports_desc: The numbers come from the same database the Foundation runs on, not from a spreadsheet kept on the side.
landing.access_portal_desc: Coordination, teaching, accounting, counselling and students. Invitation only: nobody signs themselves up.
landing.access_meals_desc: Sign up for lunch before 8:30 AM. It is an open page — no account needed.
landing.access_appointment_desc: Students request a confidential appointment from their own portal, without going through coordination.
landing.footerTagline: Bringing Hope · Changing Lives · Transforming Communities
landing.chain_contribution_value: A contribution with a date and an amount
landing.faqTitle: Exclusive access for active students and Foundation staff
landing.faqIntro: Nexus is the internal management platform for Global Effect Foundation programs in La Vega.
landing.faq_q1_title: Who can access the Nexus portal?
landing.faq_q1_desc: The portal is strictly intended for active enrolled students, employees, teachers, and administrative staff. Access is provided solely via direct invitation from coordination.
landing.faq_q2_title: How does daily lunch registration work?
landing.faq_q2_desc: Active students and staff can sign up daily between 6:00 AM and 8:30 AM via the meals page or portal to organize lunch prep without food waste.
landing.faq_q3_title: How do active students access grades and appointments?
landing.faq_q3_desc: Active students sign in with their assigned institutional credentials to view academic progress by term and request confidential counseling appointments.
landing.faq_q4_title: How do administrative staff and teachers manage their duties?
landing.faq_q4_desc: Teachers and administration have dedicated modules for entering grades, tracking tasks, managing projects, overseeing lunch rosters, and system reports.
